name: G-III Apparel Group
outlook:
What G-III Apparel Group says to expect

  • Third quarter fiscal 2027: net salesNet sales for the third quarter of fiscal 2027 are expected to be approximately $870.0 million. This compares to net sales of $988.6 million in last year’s third quarter.
  • Third quarter fiscal 2027: net incomeNet income for the third quarter of fiscal 2027 is expected to be between $59.0 million and $64.0 million, or diluted earnings per share between $1.35 and $1.45.
  • Fiscal 2027: net salesNet sales for fiscal 2027 are expected to be approximately $2.71 billion, which incorporates the loss of approximately $460 million of sales from Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger products.
  • Fiscal 2027: adjusted EBITDAAdjusted EBITDA is expected to be between $174.0 million and $178.0 million compared to adjusted EBITDA of $192.4 million in fiscal 2026.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed September 2, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
